## Your rights

Depending on the circumstances, you may ask for access to your data, correction, deletion, restriction of processing, or a portable copy, and you may object to processing based on legitimate interests. Where processing relies on consent, you may withdraw it at any time without affecting earlier lawful processing. Some rights have legal exceptions. Send a request to [INSERT: monitored privacy email address]; we may need to verify your identity before acting.

You may complain to the data protection supervisory authority in [INSERT: controller's EU/EEA country and authority name/link], or to an authority in the country where you live or work or where the alleged infringement occurred. [CHOOSE: For a Danish controller, the authority is Datatilsynet, https://www.datatilsynet.dk/borger/klage/saadan-klager-du; otherwise replace it.]
